title: Kinesis connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Kinesis connector instance's settings: the stream, its region, where the per-shard checkpoints are kept, and the consumer's options including enhanced fan-out. `access_key_id` and `secret_access_key` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list; with the AWS role chain they are absent.

stream.description: The Kinesis stream name or ARN.

endpoint.description: A Kinesis-compatible endpoint, for floci (D60) in CI (CN1 Tech Stack). AWS when absent.

access_key_id.description: The static access key id. Resolved through the secret store (D189); absent when the role chain is used.

secret_access_key.description: The static secret access key. Resolved through the secret store (D189); absent when the role chain is used.

session_token.description: A session token, when the credentials are temporary. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

role_arn.description: The role Loams assumes; the default AWS credential chain is used when absent (the manifest's `iam` auth slug).

shards.description: The shards to read, or all of them when absent; the source checkpoints a sequence number per shard.

consumer_name.description: The enhanced-fan-out consumer registered against the stream (CN1 Task 13: enhanced fan-out optional).

enhanced_fan_out.description: Register a consumer and use SubscribeToShard, which gives per-shard server-side filtering but costs a subscription per shard.

checkpoint_table.description: The Fabric table the per-shard sequence numbers are committed to, as <namespace>._fabric.flow_positions is for native sources (CN1 plan Architecture); absent uses the Fabric's own position store.

follow_parent_shards.description: Keep reading through a resharding by following a closed shard's parent and then its children (CN1 Task 13's kinesis_resharding_followed).

batch_records.description: Records per GetRecords or PutRecords call.

poll_interval_ms.description: How long a GetRecords call waits before returning empty.

parallel_gets.description: Concurrent GetRecords calls across the shards.

partial_failure_retries.description: Retries of the failed records in a partial PutRecords failure (CN1 Task 13's kinesis_put_records_partial_failure).

partition_key.description: The explicit partition key for the sink, where the route does not set the partitionkey extension.
